items.phrase: have got a brother and a sister

items.example: How many brothers have you got?
What are their names? — Paul and Lisa.
And how old is Joel? — He's twenty-five.
And has he got a job? — Yes, he's the manager.
They bring up sixteen children in one house.
Neighbours look after the kids after school.
Jeni and Ray spend time with the kids every evening.
The kids definitely feel loved and happy.
They're great parents — they really love their big family.
They have got a bakery in town.
